title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 43
description: Ten questions on Psalms 43: a plea for vindication, God's light and truth leading to his holy hill, and hope in God.

questions.text: Against whom does the psalmist ask God to plead his cause in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says, "Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation."

questions.text: From whom does the psalmist ask to be delivered in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says, "Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men."

questions.text: What does the psalmist call God at the start of verse 2?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says, "For you are the God of my strength."

questions.text: Why does the psalmist go mourning, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 asks, "Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?"

answers.text: Because of a long famine in the land
Because of the oppression of the enemy
Because of a sickness in his body
Because of the death of a friend

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask God to send out to lead him?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says, "Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me."

questions.text: Where should God's light and truth bring the psalmist?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says, "Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents."

answers.text: To the land of his fathers
To God's holy hill, to his tents

questions.text: Where will the psalmist then go, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says, "Then I will go to the altar of God."

questions.text: How does the psalmist describe God in verse 4?
On what instrument will the psalmist praise God?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says, "I will praise you on the harp, God, my God."

questions.text: In verse 5, whom does the psalmist address with the question "Why are you in despair?"
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says, "Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me?"
